query: What do Samsung Galaxy S9 reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?
search_text: What do reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?

rows.text: Awesome Device and Happy w/ Seller. So I bought from Bcfly4 and this review is for them as much as it is for the S9. The S9 is a great phone. Replacing the screen is about 280-300 bucks though so it's about the same to just buy a refurb and start over. Also the international S9 can run Lineage OS and /e/ OS so super excited. Thanks
Good item.. I bought two phones. One had scratches on case and screen. The second one was in ideal shape, but the screen had some burnin. Overall, both phones are working perfectly.

NO MORE SAMSUNG FOR ME!. This is my 4th Galaxy phone and my last. One month into owning the S9 the dreaded and well-documented 'flickering green screen' starting happening. None of the online quick fixes worked for me except for keeping the brightness level at 10% or 90%+. Fortunately, the phone is under a 60 day return policy so back it goes. This is a known software issue that Samsung won't acknowledge. There are new phones like the One Plus Nord N200 that cost the same and have the latest OS and updates. That's where I'm headed. Beware. No more Samsung for me!

Phone picture is not to clear do to double screen. The fingerprint area is scratched & makes it hard to read my print. There is also a screen behind the actual screen I'm looking at. I notified the seller, but have not heard anyback yet.

Samsung Galaxy version international does not have warranty!!!!. After 4 months of use, the telephone started to loose touch screen sensibility. I have read all the blogs and support pages and it simply does not work correctly. the touchscreen sometimes does not recognize when I write. I have contacted Samsung and they told me that that they can only support phones who are not "international versions". So, the call center recommend me to repair by myself the device because there is not warranty for this kind of devices. So, please take in consideration before you buy a new device in amazon that there is not warranty if it is a international version.

Great specs - on paper - poor in functionality. Where do I start? Oh yea the curved quirky screen - which is no more than a marketing gimmick. If you have big fingers too bad! When you are holding it like a normal phone be ready for false touches. The screen will think you are making gestures or touching the screen, when in reality you are just holding the phone. Why? Because the curved nature of the screen actually touches your thumb or finger. OK MAYBE NOT A PROBLEM IF YOU GET A THICK CASE. NOPE! Still a problem with a thick case because now you can't really use the finger print scanner! "cannot recognize fingerprint" I remove case and try and it recognizes it. The charging port stopped charging after 1 year unless I'm holding the cable in a certain position and applying pressure.
Good. Good but there's too much scratches on the screen

Best phone I've owned so far. Best performing phone I've owned - it is speedy and has a great screen. The battery life is a bit disappoing though - it can barely make it through a day of internet browsing on normal power settings. The curved screen is dumb, as there are no good screen protectors for it - you won't find any 5 star curved protectors on Amazon. I'm going without one - I like to live dangerously.

Even not in use, lithium batteries do degrade over time, so no issues here. Being careful to manage app background use, and running the phone on lowest display resolution (still looks good), I can easily get through a 16 hr day with 15-20% to spare with 3 hours or so of screen on time. Overall very pleased. Much better than any refurbished units I've had.

Keep the phone safe from screen contact with objects and, donot drop your phone.. Still can't uninstall pre-installed applications not wanted like Facebook, etc. I have a software update that keeps prompting me for download and install, and I can't disable it because I'm happy with the Os it came with. The phone get a little warm when watching videos. One hansed function is tricky, I at time have to use the one handed zoom option because the inner par part of my hand touches the edge of the inside part of the phone when stretching the thumb that the hand is in to the other side of the screen. Battery is ok when doing constant usage, my phone will work about 8-9 hrs constant use. The fingerprint sensor and reader sometimes takes a bit lengthy of a time to read my finger in standby mode. I use my phone until it is completely dead before charging it at all times.

Nice screen, nice performance. Good cell-phone. I like the screen quality and photos. Fast enough for my daily work and good storage. Works good in Argentina. This international version came with an European plug and US adaptor.

Not worth it at all. I Bought this device a few months ago and It is not worth $250 I promise it came quick and worked well out of the box but it came with screen burn in and within 3 weeks of purchase the battery would die at around 30% and when plugged in would be at 15% and the Face ID Finger Print scanner weren’t working and is way lighter, cheaper glass and screen first time it fell it cracked, its slower, it get worse service/signal and ext. then a actual galaxy S9 Purchased from Verizon...
Great prone.. The phone is amazing. The screen is awesome. The cameras take excellent pictures.

Most fragile phone I have ever owned. Because it is so slippery it is prone to dropping and because it is so fragile it breaks.. I own two of these phones purchased through Verizon. I have dropped both of them and have incurred significant damage on both phones. The Samsung Galaxy S9 is the most fragile phone I have ever owned. The phone is extremely slippery, easily dropped (even from a pocket or purse) so don't drop this slippery phone or you, too, will incur case damage or screen damage. If you do decide to buy one, be absolutely sure you have 100% device protection against damage because you will need it. Despite it's great review of applications and operation, if the phone breaks so easily that it is not usable, what is the point of owning it? By the way one of the phones had an Otter Box cases when it was dropped, because the screen is almost dead even with the case, the screen broke. Did I say to buy insurance?

Mostly Ok. I brought this product from Breed used. The sim tray was damaged and there were scratches along the sides and top of the phone. However, the screen and camera were fine and the back was mostly undamaged. The delivery time was slow and it came in a strange box, but it came working smoothly and came network unlocked, which is what matters the most to me.

Excellent. I personally have this phone and I love it! Only phone I will own. Love the beveled glass and the amazing screen display. I bought this for my wife who has always loved my phone. She is so happy with having one of her own now. I highly recommend!

In defense of this LG phone!. Wow, I had to add my little say in the matter of this phone after reading all of the bad reviews from quite a few people! I just recently did my New Every Two upgrade and stayed with LG. I had very few problems with my VX4650 and even got my parents and in-laws (my share plan partners smile the same phone after-the-fact. Now, I have to say, they probably have more problems with it than I did but they are all in their mid to late 70's and ANY phone would be confusing to them. You know, these danged contraptions smile I would say, however, that the battery problem happened to me but the Verizon store checked it out and said it was one that they were having problems with and they replaced it.

Moisture notice when battery is low & charger is plugged in.. I ordered this refurbished phone hoping it would perform as indicated and have no issues. Unfortunately the phone is not functioning as I had hoped & the return window closed 5 days ago. When the battery runs low or runs out and I plug in the charger, there is a moisture warning that pops up on the screen. This is not something I can fix, so basically I have wasted good money. I will stick to purchasing new products.

Screen Burn. Phone came with a few scratches, which I expected. However, upon closer look the screen had images burned into it. It looked like this phone was a display phone and the images got burned into the screen. I was really upset and am returning sad they're also making me pay postage to return the damaged phone ?

Better than expected.. I don't use face recognition so the review for that won't be accurate but the phone was easy to switch over from my s6. The battery life is amazing. I used to carry a power pack but all day with no battery saver on and its still on around 60%. I am online every chance i get and so is the screen that lights around when i get messages.
